use_cases.title: Use Cases & Versatility
use_cases.subtitle: An expressive motor interface crafted for sensitive daily, cognitive, and commercial contexts.
use_cases.card_1_desc: Comforting physical presence without emotional manipulation. Clear relational boundaries enforced by built-in ethical guardrails.
use_cases.card_2_desc: Designed for deep focus and neurodivergent individuals (ADHD). The robot provides a tangible physical presence anchor for sustained attention.
use_cases.card_3_desc: Rich spoken and gestural interactions across English, French, and Japanese (hiragana & nuanced keigo registers). Judgment-free practice.

safety.title: Safety, Ethics & Regulation
safety.subtitle: An uncompromising commitment to responsible and transparent embodied AI.
safety.guardrails_desc: Physical embodiment amplifies human emotional attachment. Entrelac introduces deterministic middleware guardrails to prevent harmful anthropomorphic illusions.
safety.anti_mirror_desc: Prohibition of unhealthy complaisance. Our pipeline mitigates algorithmic radicalization, resists delusions, and halts self-reinforcing cognitive loops.
safety.physical_env_desc: Continuous local verification of motor envelopes. In case of unexpected obstacle, instability, or hazardous movement, safe emergency shutdown is triggered locally.
safety.manifesto_desc: Auditable codebase, open API schemas, and proactive alignment with Canada's Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA) and NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

research.title: Expert Research & Scientific Foundations
research.subtitle: An objective, third-party academic repository guiding Entrelac's core principles.
research.intro: Our engineering is grounded in peer-reviewed science. We actively study identified psychological and robotic risks to engineer resilient safeguards.
research.item_1_title: Clinical Research on AI-Induced Psychosis (Hudon & Stip)
research.item_1_desc: Landmark investigations by Dr. Alexandre Hudon and Dr. Emmanuel Stip detailing risks of delusional exacerbation in vulnerable users interacting with conversational agents.
research.item_2_desc: Leading research and guidelines on machine learning robustness, ethical alignment, and social accountability in autonomous agents.
research.item_3_desc: Critical frameworks advocating for human primacy, non-instrumentalization, and fundamental rights in intelligent systems.

b2b_hardware.title: B2B — Robotics Hardware Manufacturers
b2b_hardware.subtitle: Bring your robotic platforms to life with our unified, sovereign software layer.
b2b_hardware.criteria_intro: To integrate with Entrelac middleware, physical robot platforms must fulfill the following technical prerequisites:
b2b_hardware.spec_1: Standard local communication interface (USB-C, Bluetooth LE, or secured local Wi-Fi socket).
b2b_hardware.spec_2: Kinematic update frequency of at least 30 Hz for expressive head/body motions.
b2b_hardware.spec_3: Hardware-level watchdog and fail-safe kill switch telemetry.
b2b_hardware.exclusion_1: Zero flight capability (aerial drones or flying devices strictly prohibited).
b2b_hardware.exclusion_2: Zero sharp, hot, puncturing, or potentially hazardous moving parts.
b2b_hardware.exclusion_3: Enforced torque and weight caps suitable for domestic and tabletop environments.

b2b_retail.title: B2B — Retail & Physical Stores
b2b_retail.subtitle: In-store greeting and concierge robots with total local governance.
b2b_retail.feature_1_desc: Strictly dictate tone, store policies, and catalog knowledge. Zero risk of off-brand hallucinations or rogue responses.
b2b_retail.feature_2_desc: Customer voices, faces, and physical motions never leave the local store perimeter. Full compliance with Quebec Law 25 and international privacy laws.
b2b_retail.feature_3_desc: In the event of an internet outage, greeting gestures, basic Q&A, and pre-programmed assistance continue without interruption.

api_guide.title: API Guide — Simplified Overview
api_guide.subtitle: How to verify if an AI model or service is compatible with Entrelac.
api_guide.intro: No robotics degree required. Here is how your preferred LLM connects with the Entrelac engine.
api_guide.step_1_desc: Does your LLM support JSON mode or structured function calling? If yes, Entrelac can translate its reasoning into fluid physical behaviors.
api_guide.step_2_desc: For natural conversational timing, a Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) under 500ms is recommended on local runners (e.g., Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM).
api_guide.step_3_desc: Connect your model's streaming endpoint to the Entrelac local daemon. The daemon handles kinematic smoothing, collision avoidance, and gestural pacing.

about.title: About Entrelac AI Inc.
about.subtitle: At the confluence of linguistics, human cognition, and sovereign robotics.
about.story_desc: Entrelac was founded on a pivotal observation: generative AI models are advancing at breathtaking speed on screens, yet physical embodiment remains locked in closed proprietary silos or dangerously indifferent to human psychological vulnerability.
about.founder_desc: Holding a Master’s degree (M.A.) in trilingual interpretation and intercultural communication (French, English, Japanese) coupled with deep expertise in modern AI engineering, the founder approaches human-robot interaction through semantic fidelity, cultural nuance, and safety by design.
about.partners_desc: Entrelac is preparing incubation with Centech (Montreal), a Mitacs Accelerate R&D research internship with IntRoLab (Université de Sherbrooke), and hardware integration pilots with TangibleFuture (LOOI platform).
